name: .alpha.-tocopherol + hydrogen peroxide + silica
uses: Uses ■ Helps whiten teeth. ■ Helps prevent cavities. ■ Helps eliminate bad breath. ■ Helps strengthen teeth. ■ Helps keep the oral cavity clean. ■ Helps freshen the oral cavity. ■ Helps improve the appearance of teeth. ■ Helps prevent gingivitis and periodontitis (pyorrhea). ■ Helps prevent periodontal disease. ■ Helps prevent gum disease. ■ Helps remove dental plaque (anti-plaque).
otcwarn: Warnings Precautions for Use ■ Do not use this product for any purpose other than brushing teeth. ■ If a large amount of this product is accidentally swallowed, follow the instructions of a pharmacist, dentist, or physician. Storage Instructions ■ Keep out of reach of children. Children should use this product only under adult supervision. ■ Avoid direct sunlight. Keep the cap tightly closed and store at room temperature. Whitening Toothpaste Warnings ■ Avoid using this product if you have mouth sores, severe cavities, or severe periodontal disease, as it may cause significant irritation. ■ If your gums become red or sore after use, discontinue use, as this whitening toothpaste may not be suitable for you. ■ This product contains hydrogen peroxide as its whitening active ingredient. The tube may swell due to the release of oxygen generated by hydrogen peroxide. This is a natural phenomenon and does not affect the quality of the product. You may also hear a sound as carbon dioxide escapes from the tube during use.
